changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE lbi_imported_table_sorgente ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, imported_table_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lbi_imported_table(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ordine INT NOT NULL, connection_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lbi_connection(id), ditta_forzata INT NULL, prefisso_chiavi VARCHAR(20) NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_sorgente_ordine UNIQUE (imported_table_id, ordine), CONSTRAINT uq_sorgente_connessione UNIQUE (imported_table_id, connection_id), CONSTRAINT ck_sorgente_ordine CHECK (ordine BETWEEN 1 AND 255), CONSTRAINT ck_sorgente_prefisso CHECK (prefisso_chiavi IS NULL OR length(prefisso_chiavi) > 0) );
